title: 소식 전하기: 결혼했어요? 합격했어요?
objective: By the end, you can use 10 words to share news about life events and react to them in short sentences, such as 합격 축하해요 or 민수 씨 소식 들었어요?
summary: Learn ten words for sharing and reacting to personal news, such as a wedding, passing an exam, or getting a job.

task.title: Share and react to news
task.line: Use the words from this worksheet to choose, fill in, or write the right Korean words.

words.exampleMeaning: Did you hear the news about Minsu?

words.meaning: contact; getting in touch (by phone, message, etc.)
words.exampleMeaning: Why haven't I heard from you lately?
A strange rumor is going around the office.

words.meaning: to pass on; to deliver (news, a message, or a thing) to someone
words.exampleMeaning: I'll pass this news on to the teacher.
The two of them dated for five years and then got married.

words.meaning: to pass (an exam); to be accepted (by a school)
words.exampleMeaning: My younger brother/sister got into university.
I've gotten much busier since I got a job.
Congratulations on your new job! Today is my treat.

words.meaning: to be surprised; to be shocked
words.exampleMeaning: I was really shocked when I saw the news.
It rained on the day we moved.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 열심히 공부해서 시험에 (합격했어요 / 이사했어요). ② 대학교를 졸업하고 여행사에 (취직했어요 / 결혼했어요). ③ 집이 좁아서 넓은 집으로 (이사했어요 / 합격했어요).
Fill in each blank with 소식, 연락, or 소문: ① 요즘 바빠서 부모님께 ____ 드리는 것을 잊었어요. ② 오늘 좋은 ____이 있어요. 언니가 아기를 낳았어요! ③ 그건 그냥 ____이에요. 아직 아무도 몰라요.
Fill in the blank with a word from this worksheet in the past tense: 친구가 갑자기 회사를 그만둬서 깜짝 ____.
Fill in the blank with a word from this worksheet: 이 선물을 할머니께 좀 ____ 주세요.
Your coworker tells you: 저 다음 주에 결혼해요! Write what you say back in Korean.
answers: ① 합격했어요 ② 취직했어요 ③ 이사했어요
① 연락 ② 소식 ③ 소문
